features.quote: Workshops: Konpa, Kizomba, Semba, Afrobeats, Gouyad & more

Bootcamps are offered in these styles, which fits the bootcamp or intensive training feature.
A host hotel is named for dancers, but the text does not say accommodation is part of the pass.
